summary: Use ansible-navigator with -m stdout to run familiar Ansible commands such as ansible-playbook inside execution environments or locally. Help is available with --help on any subcommand (for example ansible-navigator config --help) and subcommand help such as --help-config lists the related Ansible command's parameters.
questions: How do I run ansible-navigator in stdout mode?
How do I get help for an ansible-navigator subcommand?
